sources: https://www.cpwshop.com/camping/state-forest-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=50042 (Bockman site list, prices and campsiteDetails pages)

hookups.source: cpwshop.com parkID 50042: all 51 Bockman sites are type 'Basic' with no hookup attributes (co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl) + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/state-forest-state-park/state-forest-state-park-camping-lodging, read 2026-10-27

values.note: 51 basic sites: 12 pull-throughs listed at 80-114 ft and 39 back-ins at 46-69 ft.

sites.source: cpwshop.com parkID 50042 Bockman sites (Maximum Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry; co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Park amenities: hand-pumped water and spigots, vault toilets, a dump station. Water is shut off October 31; the dump station then supplies potable water.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/state-forest-state-park/state-forest-state-park-camping-lodging ('Amenities include: ADA accessibility, Vault toilets, Electrical hook-ups, Dump station, Hand-pumped water and water spigots'; 'Oct. 31 - Water will be turned off. At that time, use the dump station for potable water'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon. Display a vehicle pass.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/state-forest-state-park/state-forest-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at State Forest State Park ... cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period. A maximum of six people, two motorized vehicles and only one camping unit'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Basic sites $28 a night in June, a Saturday the same. Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a daily vehicle pass or an annual Colorado state parks pass.

fees.source: cpwshop.com parkID 50042 Bockman 1-night prices for 2027-06-15 and 2027-06-19 (co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl) + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/state-forest-state-park/state-forest-state-park-camping-lodging ('Visitors are required to display a vehicle pass'), read 2026-10-27

note: Large loop at ~9,280 ft about 1 mi N of North Michigan Reservoir in State Forest State Park (North Park); horse corrals on site. --Claude
